title: The History of 3D Graphics on the Gameboy Advance | minimme
summary: minimme traces the timeline of 3D graphics engines on the Game Boy Advance, from early experiments to commercial 3D games, covering techniques such as voxel rendering. It is a history and showcase of what developers coaxed out of the limited hardware.
why: HN people recommend it as the best overview of how 3D on the GBA progressed over the console's life, usually in threads about GBA ports and homebrew 3D engines.

quote.text: For a good overview of the progress of 3d GBA graphics over the console's lifespan I'd reccomended this video history
